one_liner_zh: 美超微營收年增逾122%、獲利大幅超預期，AI伺服器需求爆發但毛利與本益比偏低反映品質疑慮。
one_liner_en: Super Micro beat sharply with 122%+ revenue growth on booming AI server demand, though thin margins and low PE reflect quality concerns.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 0.84美元優於預估0.62美元，意外幅度34.51%，營收年增122.68%。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正面但須留意品質：營收年增逾122%與獲利大超預期，確立其為AI伺服器主要受惠者；但16.35倍本益比偏低，反映市場對毛利率、客戶集中與治理風險的折價。短期業績動能強勁，惟須觀察毛利率是否因競爭與GPU成本而下滑。中期關鍵在於液冷產能、Blackwell機櫃出貨與現金流改善。追蹤毛利率、存貨週轉、客戶分散度與審計合規進展，評估折價是否收斂。
ai_view_en: Positive but mind the quality: 122%+ revenue growth and a large earnings beat confirm SMCI as a key AI-server beneficiary, yet the 16.35x PE reflects a discount for margins, customer concentration, and governance risk. Near-term momentum is strong, but watch whether gross margin slips on competition and GPU costs. Mid-term hinges on liquid-cooling capacity, Blackwell rack shipments, and cash-flow improvement. Track gross margin, inventory turns, customer diversification, and audit/compliance progress to see if the discount narrows.
highlights_zh: 營收102.4億美元，年增122.68%，AI伺服器需求強勁
EPS 0.84美元，優於預估0.62美元，意外幅度34.51%
受惠GPU伺服器與液冷機櫃出貨放量
本益比僅16.35倍，相對AI族群評價偏低
與輝達等GPU供應鏈深度綁定，先發優勢明顯
highlights_en: Revenue of $10.24B, up 122.68% YoY on strong AI server demand
EPS of $0.84 beat the $0.62 estimate, a 34.51% surprise
Driven by GPU server and liquid-cooled rack shipments
PE of just 16.35x, low relative to AI peers
Deep ties to Nvidia's GPU supply chain provide a first-mover edge
risks_zh: 硬體組裝毛利率偏低，成長伴隨利潤稀釋
曾有財報延遲與會計疑慮，公司治理信任度待修復
GPU供給、客戶集中與價格競爭壓力大
risks_en: Low hardware-assembly margins mean growth comes with margin dilution
Prior filing delays and accounting concerns leave governance trust to rebuild
GPU supply, customer concentration, and pricing competition are pressures
